lines.text: When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, the singers say they were like dreamers.
Their mouths were filled with laughter, and the nations said the LORD had done great things for them.
The singers say the LORD has done great things for them, and they are filled with fear.
They pray for the LORD to restore their captives like streams in the Jordan.
Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
